Validate the tracker IMEIs recorded on a survey

Source: R/validation-functions.R
validate_imeis.Rd

Enumerators record as many digits of the tracker IMEI as they can read, so a recorded value is matched against the deployed devices by suffix. A value short enough to be ambiguous, or matching no device, is flagged.

Usage

validate_imeis(submissions, deployed_imeis)

Arguments

submissions

Output of validation_submissions().

deployed_imeis

Character vector of deployed device IMEIs.

Value

A tibble: imei, alert_number, submission_id.

Details

The roster spans every device ever deployed, since a submission from any year can reference one.
